description: This file contains extension methods, interface definitions, and class implementations for configuring Azure Queue Stream providers within Orleans hosting and clustering contexts. It provides extension methods for setting up queue options, data adapters, cache sizes, and default queue names, as well as concrete configurator classes for silo and cluster client components.

classes.name: SiloAzureQueueStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class for setting up Azure Queue stream options and defaults for silo hosts.

classes.name: ClusterClientAzureQueueStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator class for setting up Azure Queue stream options and defaults for cluster clients.

methods.name: ConfigureAzureQueue
methods.description: Extension method to configure AzureQueueOptions with a specified options builder action.

methods.name: ConfigureQueueDataAdapter
methods.description: Extension method to set up a queue data adapter factory for the stream configurator.

methods.name: ConfigureQueueDataAdapter<TQueueDataAdapter>
methods.description: Generic extension method that configures a specific IQueueDataAdapter implementation.

methods.name: ConfigureCacheSize
methods.description: Extension method to set the cache size for Azure Queue stream cache options.

methods.name: SiloAzureQueueStreamConfigurator (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the silo configurator, setting default queue names and queue options.

methods.name: ClusterClientAzureQueueStreamConfigurator (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the cluster client configurator, setting default queue names and queue options.
